mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.0% signals labor market strength and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE < 7.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in housing starts and real consumption expenditures (both >0.5%) indicates robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase >0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise >0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession manufacturing recovery (INDPRO > 100 and rising for 3 consecutive months), industrial production growth supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods in the post-recession manufacturing recovery regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (above 900,000 units) signals strong residential construction activity, boosting near-term economic confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when HOUST > 900,000 units, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined growth in employment (PAYEMS > 0.5% month-over-month) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 0.1% decline) indicates a robust labor market, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when PAYEMS rises >0.5% and UNRATE falls >0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.5%), economic uncertainty depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
